provenance: Reported by the author (2026-09-11): measured on a separate server under the same protocol as the E21 NAR rows (default per-channel GPTQ weights, 4.25-bit asymmetric group-128 activations, E14 KIVI cache, 141 WikiText-2 windows of 2048 tokens, same lm-eval harness and metric conventions). Not run or reproduced in this pipeline; raw harness output and checkpoint are not in this repository.
precision_note: At two decimals, ARC-c, ARC-e, BoolQ, PIQA, SIQA and WinoGrande are not attainable as correct/total for their test sets (1172, 2376, 3270, 1838, 1954, 1267 items); all are attainable at one decimal. The values are therefore treated as 0.1-point precision. The mean is the mean of the rounded values.
